title: March of the Dead
description: Ash spawn have been attacking Raven Rock. Captain Veleth enlists help to find their source, leading to the reanimated General Falx Carius at Fort Frostmoth who must be stopped.

base_facts: I am the captain of the Redoran Guard in Raven Rock, serving under Councilor Morvayn.
Ash spawn have been attacking Raven Rock and I am trying to locate their source.
I lack the manpower to investigate without leaving the town undefended.

ASH_SPAWN_ENCOUNTER: A stranger helped me fight off ash spawn at Old Attius Farm. I have asked them to search for clues.
SEARCH_FARM: The stranger found a Declaration of War note written by General Falx Carius. I sent them to Fort Frostmoth to deal with him.
FORT_FROSTMOTH: I am awaiting word from the stranger about General Carius at Fort Frostmoth.
RETURN_AND_REPORT: The stranger has slain General Falx Carius and ended the ash spawn threat. Councilor Morvayn authorized a reward.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The ash spawn attacks on Raven Rock have ceased with General Falx Carius destroyed. Veleth suspected Carius was undead all along.
Veleth expressed regret over Carius's fate, noting there are many tales of his exploits including the founding of Raven Rock.
Councilor Morvayn authorized a bounty of leveled gold as reward for eliminating the ash spawn threat.
Once both the ash spawn threat is resolved and the ebony mine reopened, Veleth will offer another task regarding an assassination plot against Councilor Morvayn.

base_facts: I was the Imperial garrison commander at Fort Frostmoth over 200 years ago.
I died when Red Mountain erupted but was reanimated by a conjurer using heartstones.
I believe I am still defending the Empire and sending my men against the enemies at Raven Rock.

QUEST_COMPLETE: General Falx Carius was slain at Fort Frostmoth, ending his reanimated crusade against the people of Raven Rock.
He was reanimated by the conjurer Ildari Sarothril using heartstones, but became hostile and uncontrollable, forcing her to abandon the experiment.
His enchanted warhammer Champion's Cudgel was claimed from his remains after his defeat.

beats.comment: Player encounters Veleth fighting ash spawn at Old Attius Farm and helps him defeat them.
Player searches the farm for clues, finds the Declaration of War note, and gives it to Veleth who sends them to Fort Frostmoth.
Player travels to Fort Frostmoth and kills the reanimated General Falx Carius.
Player returns to Raven Rock, searches Carius's remains, reads the note, reports to a guard, and gives the note to Veleth.
Quest complete. Veleth rewards the player with leveled gold and Champion's Cudgel.
